Class ShotLog

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.ShotLog
public final class ShotLog extends Object
One row per volley, under Shooting/Log/: what was aimed, and what the mechanisms were doing, on the loop the feed opened. From the offseason bot's shot record (eb2d86e, ShotCalc/Shot/*), extended with the gate's view and the pose's trust. Schema and how to read it: docs/shot-log.md; tools/shot_log.py turns a log into a CSV.

The row is written on the rising edge of the feed: the first loop fuel is allowed into the flywheel, and so the last loop on which the aim is still a prediction. When the feed closes, an end row under Shooting/Log/End/ gives the volley's length and how many flywheel dips (roughly, balls) it saw.

AdvantageKit writes a value only when it changes, so a key that is the same as last shot's has no record at this shot's time. Read a row as each key's last value at or before the row's Index record; the tool does exactly that. Main thread only, like every Telemetry call.
